_dimensionsEvaluated_comment: Only the dimensions you actually evaluated. Each one scores 50/50 if it has no findings; any of the 8 not listed shows as 'Not evaluated' and is left out of the overall score. Keep this the same across re-audits you want to compare.
complianceBaseline: WCAG 2.1 AA — HHS Section 504 (recipient, confirmed by client)
_complianceBaseline_comment: Which accessibility standard this client is held to. Confirm with the client at audit setup — see references/regulatory-context.md. Use 'Not confirmed — client to advise' rather than guessing.
_sampleNote_comment: Set to a string like 'This sample covers N of 8 dimensions...' for demo/partial audits, or null to omit for a full audit.
overallNarrative: The site covers the basics, but booking an appointment, the most important task on it, is harder than it should be: new patients must create an account before seeing open times, form errors wipe their entries, and keyboard and screen reader users can't finish at all. Accessibility is the weakest area and should be fixed first; several of those fixes also make booking easier for everyone.
_overallNarrative_comment: One to two plain-language sentences on where the site stands and what matters most — written for someone who only reads the executive summary.
roadmapArc: Protect the audience. Improve the experience. Earn their trust.
_roadmapArc_comment: Optional narrative tying the phases together. Set to null to omit. Adapt to what's actually in each phase — see Roadmap Phase Naming in SKILL.md.

roadmapPhases.name: 1. Foundation & Compliance
roadmapPhases.focus: Fix the accessibility failures that block keyboard and screen reader users (focus, contrast, the booking button, form errors, the reset CAPTCHA) and add emergency guidance.

roadmapPhases.name: 2. Core Experience Improvements
roadmapPhases.focus: Rework appointment booking: availability before sign-up, a step indicator, preserved form entries, and a mobile-friendly date picker; surface bill pay and the patient portal.

roadmapPhases.name: 3. Polish & Content Refinement
roadmapPhases.focus: Rewrite the insurance FAQ in plain language and group it, standardize terminology and button styles, and tidy remaining copy.
